tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List supported region IDs and their included city/state addresses. Regions may overlap; these are not distance or service-area boundaries.

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Search current enrichment provider records by natural-language interests in a required region: pass the place the family names (city, neighborhood or area) or a region ID. Jev maps it onto a covered region in parallel with embedding the query, and the response region is the region searched; call lis

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Get the current provider record using a UUID returned by search_providers. Does not verify current offerings or availability.

tools.name: open_provider_explorer
tools.description: Open provider exploration with current records for up to 25 unique UUIDs returned by discovery. Omit provider_ids to start without results; pass [] only after a successful search with no matches. Preserves supplied order without reranking. A missing record fails the whole request.
